scripts.build: npm run registry && npm run build -w @hash-ui/docs
scripts.build:lib: npm run build -w hash-ui && npm run build -w @hash-ui/blocks
scripts.build:all: npm run build:lib && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w hash-ui && npm run typecheck -w @hash-ui/blocks && npm run typecheck -w @hash-ui/docs
scripts.test: npm run test -w hash-ui && npm run test -w @hash-ui/blocks
